summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hosting weights and artifacts) and developer-facing inference platforms (serving those models via APIs). Hugging Face remains the dominant hub, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads and the top 0.01% account for nearly half of all downloads. Alongside it, inference-focused platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, Replicate, and local runtimes like Ollama have grown rapidly, driven by surging open-weight adoption (notably Chinese models now surpassing the U.S. in monthly downloads).

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and Spaces, with an inference layer (Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference API) for deploying and running models.
platforms.pricing: Free public hosting; Pro at ~$9/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute-hour (GPU/CPU tiers); Enterprise Hub custom pricing; pay-as-you-go serverless inference credits.
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces repository
Git-based versioning and model cards
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Download-stats tracking via query files to avoid double counting
Community collaboration, discussions, and leaderboards
Integration with major ML frameworks and cloud providers
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations needing broad model discovery, sharing, versioning, and flexible hosting/inference.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that lets developers download, manage, and run open LLMs directly on their own machines with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models/variants in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees (you supply your own hardware); Ollama Cloud/hosted options emerging with usage-based pricing.
features: One-command local model pull and run
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
OpenAI-compatible local API endpoint
Quantized GGUF models for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Offline, private inference with no data leaving the device
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users wanting fast, free, local experimentation and on-device inference.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (LLMs, image, video, audio) via API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (Cog-packaged)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-output for some models; no subscription required.
features: Run thousands of public models via simple API calls
Cog packaging for custom model deployment
Autoscaling and cold-start management
Strong support for image/video/audio generation (e.g., FLUX, SDXL)
Fine-tuning for select models
Per-second billing with scale-to-zero
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting quick API access to multimodal open models without infrastructure overhead.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs, offering fast serverless APIs and dedicated GPU deployments.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (tiered by model size); dedicated GPU instances billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token/job.
features: OpenAI-compatible API with high throughput
Serverless and dedicated inference options
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
GPU clusters for training (Together GPU Clusters)
Optimized inference stack for low latency
Broad catalog of leading open-weight models
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises building production LLM applications on open models at scale with fine-tuning needs.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open and open-weight generative models, focused on low latency and production serving.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Stable Diffusion, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (by model size); on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning fees.
features: FireAttention-optimized high-speed inference
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling and JSON mode support
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
Multimodal and image generation support
Compound AI / agentic workflow tooling
platforms.best_for: Performance-sensitive developers and enterprises needing fast, cost-efficient production inference for open models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the Chinese and Asian markets) serving a wide range of open-weight LLMs and multimodal models via unified APIs.
platforms.model_count: Dozens to 100+ open models, with strong coverage of Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Yi)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token usage-based pricing; free tiers/credits for some models; competitive low-cost rates.
features: Unified OpenAI-compatible API
Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models
Text, image, audio, and video model support
Low-latency optimized serving
Free quotas for select popular models
Scalable serverless inference
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) wanting affordable access to top Chinese and global open-weight models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware, serving popular open-weight LLMs at very high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Gemma)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token usage-based pricing; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise plans.
features: LPU-based hardware for extreme inference speed
OpenAI-compatible API
Very low latency / high tokens-per-second
Curated high-demand open models
Function calling and structured output support
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-critical applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with a small markup; credits-based; no subscription.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing
Transparent per-model pricing comparison
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Usage analytics and spend controls
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting flexible, provider-agnostic access and easy switching between many models.
